documents.title: Expenditures & Revenues Study Committee Final Report
documents.summary: A year-long independent review of Brookline's revenue and spending trends. The committee looked at what's driving the gap between the town's revenue growth (around 3% per year under Prop 2.5) and its cost growth (5-8% in areas like healthcare and debt service). Includes a three-tier override proposal and nine structural reform recommendations for the Schools.
keyTopics: Nine structural reform conditions for Schools
Special education spending on non-resident students

documents.title: Town of Brookline FY2025 Budget
documents.summary: The adopted operating budget for fiscal year 2025. Covers all town and school department appropriations, revenue projections, and staffing levels. Total budget of roughly $400M, with education making up about 59% of spending.

documents.title: FY2026-FY2030 Long Range Financial Plan
documents.summary: Five-year financial projections for the town, covering FY2026 through FY2030. Shows how revenue and expenses are expected to grow under current policies, and where the gaps are likely to appear. This is the main source for the projected deficit figures that the ERSC report builds on.
keyTopics: Projected structural deficit by fiscal year

documents.title: Article 9: FY2026 Budget (Advisory Committee Recommendation)
documents.summary: The Advisory Committee's recommendation and vote on the FY2026 operating budget (Article 9 of Town Meeting). This is the formal warrant article that Town Meeting voted on to adopt the FY2026 budget.
